The rules · and what it won't do

Why you can trust it at 9pm on a Tuesday

Say “approved” or it doesn't save.Every save confirmed back. No silent writes.
It drafts. You send.Never emails a vendor, never posts, never publishes.
It never invents a number.Unknown means it asks — or marks it unknown.
Vendor privacy by default.First names only unless the vendor approves more.
It won't act on its own.Briefings and checks happen when you ask. Nothing auto-sends.
It won't touch the legal layer.Not connected, not read, not summarised.
It won't game reviews.No incentives, no scripting. Real or it's worthless — to the platforms, the machine, and your licence.
Setup honesty.Portal-sourced until verified · your voice from your real updates · unknowns marked, never filled.
